answer_2.quote: To quantify stance-change dynamics, we defined the metrics detailed in Table (Formal mathematical definitions in Appendix G). These metrics were selected to capture: (i) baseline Knowledge (Acc@0), (ii) Robustness against misinformation (NEG-Acc@n), (iii) Gullibility (NEG-Flip@n), and (iv) Receptiveness to correction (POS-Acc@n, POS-Flip@n).
